description: Visitor check-in and Teams meeting notes for Microsoft 365 offices: kiosk or QR sign-in with host alerts, plus AI minutes.
pricing: 15-day free trial, no credit card needed. Plan pricing is provided on request.
notes: For building and workplace teams, Kahrbon replaces the paper visitor book: guests check themselves in at a lobby tablet or by scanning a one-time QR code, the employee they are visiting is alerted by email and inside the app, and the full arrival history can be downloaded as CSV for audits. Employee lists come from Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace, so hosts do not have to be entered by hand. The same subscription adds a Microsoft Teams note taker that produces speaker-labelled transcripts and AI minutes with assigned, dated action items.
